name: rea-integration
description: Reverse Engineer Anything (REA) integration with Aetherius/Genesis ecosystem

proposedExperiment.name: REA Small Application Investigation
proposedExperiment.description: Investigate a small source-owned JavaScript/Electron application using REA tools, derive feature specification, build independently implemented equivalent, and verify functionality
acceptanceCriteria: REA tool connection is confirmed on the active agent
Analysis produces retained evidence with source references
Genesis identifies observable behaviour and unresolved questions
An original implementation is generated in an isolated workspace
Automated behaviour tests pass against a defined specification
Resource usage, execution time and tool failures are recorded
Findings are registered without duplicating existing Aetherius capabilities

capabilityRegistry.name: REA Integration Capability
capabilityRegistry.description: Provides reverse-engineering analysis capabilities for investigating existing software, identifying mechanisms, and informing independently authored implementations

nextSteps: Install REA and verify OpenCode client compatibility
Run REA analysis on test application
Assess resource usage and integration overhead
